coverageNotes: Region nbo-kilimani (Kilimani, Hurlingham, Upper Hill, Milimani, Woodley, Adams Arcade, Ngong Road, Dagoretti, Kawangware). The web search tool is US-centric and returned mostly rental listings and generic blogs, so yield was low; 16 evidenced records (7 not in seed, 9 in seed with new details) and 14 unverified leads. KILIMANI: found UpFit (Galana Plaza), aqtive studio (Zarafa Towers, Ring Rd), Femina Fit (Lana Plaza, Oloitoktok Rd, on the Kileleshwa border), Yaya Hotel gym, plus new details for Hyat Fitness and Ultra Fitness (directory-only). No CrossFit box, martial-arts school or women-only gym other than Femina Fit/aqtive yoga was found. Raw Gym (Valley Arcade) could not be verified because its domain does not resolve. HURLINGHAM: no standalone gym with a findable page; only hotel gyms (Four Points, DoubleTree) whose official pages were blocked, listed as leads. 'Hurlingham Gym' and 'Kilimani Fitness/Yoga' on achisystems.co.ke were rejected: that directory is templated with placeholder contacts. UPPER HILL: found Best Western Nairobi Upper Hill and Nairobi Club (Ngong Road, members-only) with usable pages; Radisson Blu, Crowne Plaza, Fairview and Hillpark gyms are leads only because the sites returned 403/503; Flex Health & Fitness (off Ragati Rd) is unverified. MILIMANI: ZUMA at the YMCA on State House Road (in seed) gained an address and class times; Royal Nairobi Golf Club gym (Muchai Drive off Ngong Road) is new with a 2026 page; no other Milimani gym found. NGONG ROAD / ADAMS ARCADE: Impala Club, Reforma Pilates (GreenHouse Mall), Colosseum, Alpha Fit and Smart Gyms Junction gained addresses or hours; Colosseum and Alpha Fit own sites carry 2021 and 2018 footers so status is unknown. WOODLEY: no gym, club or studio found online. DAGORETTI and KAWANGWARE: almost no online presence; only the directory-level ONE GYM and Aerobics record plus a ladies' gym lead at Dagoretti Corner (Gym Yetu, page unreachable). The seed venues Shark Fitness, Hardrock, Vapor Gym, Mountain View Fitness and Braeburn Gym returned no external pages. Kenya Boxing Club (seed): its own site only returned a title; a directory snippet places it on Ngong Road in Dagoretti but it was not opened. Not used: nairobionline.com, samplechat.aldine.edu.in, imageserver.redfishgroup.co.uk (generic or fabricated-looking pages with implausible phone numbers). Several seed venues' websites did not resolve on 2026-10-13 (racingsportgym.com, pumpfitness.co.ke, eafitness.co.ke, avfitness.ke, nairobiclub.or.ke); this is not proof of closure but suggests a recheck of Racing Sport Gym, Pump Fitness, EA Fitness and AV Fitness. The Nation article on women-only gyms and most hotel-chain sites returned 403. Evidence quotes were taken from the text returned by the fetch tool (page extractions), not from raw HTML.
